title: Add Kit Artifact Selector UI
description: Add a new Semio UI component for selecting kit artifacts (designs, types, ports) supporting partial/full controlled/uncontrolled modes and partial/full select constraints. Wire it into the semio engine MCP app so start_working_in_design opens the MCP app rendering this selector.
summary: Added `KitArtifactSelect` to semio/ui with Semio-standard controllable data+selection and group enable constraints. Extended the engine MCP app payload to include kit artifacts and updated the MCP app UI to render the selector. Refactored `start_working_in_design` to open the MCP app directly and adjusted engine tests accordingly.
